caption:
The last tweak. Again.

A tiny nudge. Another crop. Six options that are definitely different.

I’m building LOOKSi, a photo + video editor for professionals and hobbyists who care how it looks.

What’s your “last tweak” — the thing you always go back for?

slides.headline: The last tweak. Again.
slides.body: One final tiny change. You know how this goes.
slides.alt: On graphite black, large white type reads The last tweak, with a red correction adding Again. A tilted cream poster with overlapping RGB circular geometry is the recurring graphic. The lower line reads You know how this goes. This is original campaign artwork, not product output.

slides.headline: A little right.
slides.alt: The same original cream poster is shifted beside a vertical registration guide. Red and green arrows point in opposite directions. Large type reads A little right, then …or left. The bottom reads Just checking and +12 px. This is a graphic editing joke rather than an app interface.

slides.headline: Maybe another crop.
slides.alt: An oversized crop of the recurring RGB poster fills a wide window, cutting through its typography and circular image. White crop marks and red alternate corners surround it. The words Maybe another crop are followed by or… this? The crop is an original campaign illustration.

slides.headline: A few options.
slides.alt: Six subtly different versions of the original cream RGB poster are arranged in two rows of three, labeled Almost 01 through Almost 06. A loose red ellipse selects the fourth. The large heading reads A few options, followed by Yes, they’re different.

slides.headline: One more pixel.
slides.alt: The selected original RGB poster returns with crop marks and a cursor. A red leader points to an illustrative magnified grid with one red square and the label 1 px. Large red italic type reads One more pixel; a lower line says You get it. The grid is a joke prop and represents no product feature.

slides.headline: I’m building LOOKSi.
slides.body: Photo + video. For people who care how it looks. What’s your “last tweak”?
slides.alt: A clear typographic closing panel says I’m building LOOKSi, Photo + video, and For people who care how it looks. A red italic question asks What’s your last tweak? Three thin RGB circles sign the panel.

provenance: Original procedural vector artwork matches campaign04’s recurring poster. No reference creative, stock art, app interface, app output, founder likeness or product-action claim. The editable-text SVGs embed the bundled OFL fonts; portable SVGs outline those fonts for exact rendering.
render_pipeline: Native SVG geometry and live type → CoreText font outlines → Quick Look square wrapper at1350px → remove unused right gutter to1080×1350. PNG typography derives from the same outlined SVG master.
remaining: Final creative/caption/placement review only; no founder filming or product capture required.
